# How to Factory Reset an HTC One VX

**Important:** A factory reset will erase all data on your phone. Back up important photos, contacts, and files before proceeding.

## Method 1: Through the Settings Menu (if phone is working)

1. Go to **Settings**
2. Tap **Backup and reset** (or **Storage** depending on your version)
3. Select **Factory data reset**
4. Tap **Reset phone**
5. Confirm by tapping **Erase everything**
6. The phone will reboot and reset itself

## Method 2: Using Hardware Buttons (if phone is unresponsive or you can't access settings)

1. Turn off the phone completely
2. Press and hold the **Volume Down** button
3. While holding Volume Down, press and hold the **Power** button
4. Continue holding both buttons until you see a screen with options (usually white text on a black background)
5. Use the **Volume buttons** to navigate to **FACTORY RESET**
6. Press the **Power button** to select it
7. Confirm the reset when prompted (usually by pressing Volume Up to confirm, or following on-screen instructions)
8. Wait for the process to complete — the phone will reboot automatically

## Additional Notes

- Make sure your phone has sufficient battery charge (at least 50%) before starting
- If your phone is linked to a Google account, you may need to enter those credentials after the reset (due to Factory Reset Protection)
- This process will remove all apps, settings, and personal data, returning the phone to its original factory state

If you run into a specific issue during the process, let me know and I can help troubleshoot further!
